en.noui.switch.title: Switch to lilOS with the UI?
en.noui.switch.text: The kernel restarts with its page and installs the system apps (the first time it takes a few minutes), then lilOS opens in its window. Users, files and the lilos command stay as they are.
en.welcome.title: Welcome to lilOS
en.welcome.subtitle: Choose where it runs. You can add other servers later, from the Control Panel.
en.welcome.addSubtitle: Another lilOS to open with this program, each in its own window.
en.welcome.local.title: On this computer
en.welcome.local.text: The program installs and starts the kernel and the database: no Docker, no Node.js, no browser needed. Your data stay in
en.welcome.local.exists: lilOS already runs on this computer with this program.
en.welcome.local.noRuntime: This copy of the program does not carry lilOS (development: npm run runtime).
en.welcome.remote.title: Connect to a server
en.welcome.remote.text: A lilOS on another computer or at work. Sign in with your user of that server.
en.welcome.remote.trusted: I trust this server: it may open files on this computer and change the program's settings
en.welcome.noui.title: No UI
en.welcome.noui.text: Only the kernel and the database on this computer, with no windows: you use lilOS from the `lilos` command, the command-line Terminal. Apps are not installed; modules and languages are, with `lilos appstore`.
en.welcome.noui.autostart: Start lilOS when the computer starts

en.welcome.license.text: Read it and accept it to install lilOS without UI.

en.welcome.user.text: The first user of lilOS: an administrator. You will sign in with it.
en.welcome.user.name: User name

en.welcome.work.noui: Installing lilOS without UI on this computer…
en.welcome.noui.info.win32: Open a terminal (PowerShell, Command Prompt) and type `lilos` to enter, or `lilos ls` for a single command. The new PATH works in the terminals opened from now on.
en.welcome.noui.info.darwin: Open a terminal (Terminal, iTerm) and type `lilos` to enter, or `lilos ls` for a single command. The new PATH works in the terminals opened from now on.

en.welcome.previous.keep.text: The program opens it as before. Servers: {servers}.
en.welcome.previous.fresh.title: Start from zero
en.welcome.previous.fresh.text: The program forgets its servers and settings and asks again where lilOS runs.
en.welcome.previous.fresh.local: The lilOS of this computer is put aside, not deleted: its folder is renamed with .old- and the date.
en.welcome.previous.fresh.erase: Delete the lilOS of this computer instead, with its users, files and database. It cannot be undone.
en.welcome.previous.fresh.confirm: Delete lilOS in {dir} with all its users, files and database? It cannot be undone.

en.status.unreachable.title: The server does not answer

en.status.crashed.title: The page of lilOS stopped

it.noui.switch.text: Il kernel riparte con la sua pagina e installa le app di sistema (la prima volta ci vuole qualche minuto), poi lilOS si apre nella sua finestra. Utenti, file e comando lilos restano come sono.

it.welcome.subtitle: Scegli dove deve girare. Potrai aggiungere altri server dopo, dal Pannello di controllo.
